Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

time — the hour of the day. Example: What time is the meeting?
schedule — a plan of times and activities. Example: My schedule is busy this week.
meeting — a time when people talk about work. Example: I have a meeting at ten.
email — a message you send by computer. Example: I send emails every morning.
project — a piece of work with a goal. Example: I am working on a project.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I start work at ...
• I have a meeting at ...
• I send emails in the morning.
• My schedule is busy.
• What time is the meeting?
